name: Pacific Solar
old_description: Founded in the Central Valley, our family-owned company is dedicated to helping homeowners and businesses across California take advantage of solar energy systems.
about:
Pacific Solar was founded in 1982 in the Central Valley city of Clovis, California. The family-owned business began as a local solar contractor serving homeowners and businesses across the region.

The company designs and installs custom solar energy systems for residential, commercial, and agricultural properties. Its in-house team of certified professionals handles system design, panel installation, battery storage integration, EV charger installation, thermal drone scanning for system diagnostics, and ground-mount construction, along with ongoing maintenance, repairs, and assistance with permission-to-operate requests, interconnection, and incentive paperwork.

Pacific Solar serves customers throughout Central California, including Fresno, Clovis, Sacramento, San Jose, Bakersfield, Stockton, and the Central Coast. Its client base spans homeowners, businesses, and farms seeking to reduce electricity costs and gain energy independence through rooftop, ground-mounted, and battery-backed solar arrays.

The company differentiates itself with a savings guarantee—promising to cover the difference, add panels, or refund money if a system doesn’t lower utility bills by year-end—and a 25-year workmanship guarantee covering installation-related issues. Operating entirely in-house, the family-owned firm emphasizes local accountability and certified expertise on every project.
